```{r}
input_folder <- "~/Desktop/research/Elton/CPT"
output_folder <- "~/Desktop/research/Elton/CPT_timing"

if (!dir.exists(output_folder)) {
  dir.create(output_folder)
}

csv_files <- list.files(
  path = input_folder,
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# block order
block_order <- c(1,2,2,1,2,1,1,2,1,2,2,1)

# convert block numbers to labels
block_labels <- ifelse(block_order == 1, "on", "off")

# helper function: checks if a column cell is populated
is_populated <- function(x) {
  !is.na(x) & trimws(as.character(x)) != ""
}

# helper function: safely converts values to numeric
to_num <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "None", "none", "NULL")] <- NA
  as.numeric(x)
}

for (file in csv_files) {
  
  # only read files that start with LARA followed by 3 numbers
  if (!grepl("^LARA[0-9]{3}(\\D|$)", basename(file))) {
    message("Skipping file because it does not start with LARA###: ", basename(file))
    next
  }
  
  # read full csv
  df <- read.csv(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  # find needed columns
  blocks_col <- grep("^blocks\\.thisN$", names(df), value = TRUE)[1]
  trials_rep_col <- grep("^trials\\.thisRepN$", names(df), value = TRUE)[1]
  stim_col <- grep("^stimulus\\.started$", names(df), value = TRUE)[1]
  block_stop_col <- grep("^block_instr\\.stopped$", names(df), value = TRUE)[1]
  
  if (is.na(blocks_col) || is.na(trials_rep_col) || is.na(stim_col) || is.na(block_stop_col)) {
    message("Skipping file because required columns are missing: ", basename(file))
    message("Columns found were: ", paste(names(df), collapse = ", "))
    next
  }
  
  # get the block_instr.stopped reference value
  block_instr_stopped_values <- to_num(df[[block_stop_col]])
  block_instr_stopped <- block_instr_stopped_values[!is.na(block_instr_stopped_values)][1]
  
  if (is.na(block_instr_stopped)) {
    message("Skipping file because block_instr.stopped has no usable value: ", basename(file))
    next
  }
  
  # only use rows where:
  # blocks.thisN is populated
  # AND trials.thisRepN is 0
  task_rows <- is_populated(df[[blocks_col]]) & to_num(df[[trials_rep_col]]) == 0
  
  # extract stimulus.started only from those rows
  stimulus_started <- to_num(df[[stim_col]][task_rows])
  
  # remove blank/NA stimulus values
  stimulus_started <- stimulus_started[!is.na(stimulus_started)]
  
  # make sure we have exactly 12 block-start trials
  if (length(stimulus_started) < 12) {
    message("Skipping file because fewer than 12 block-start trials were found: ", basename(file))
    message("Block-start trials found: ", length(stimulus_started))
    next
  }
  
  # only use the first trial from each of the 12 blocks
  stimulus_started <- stimulus_started[1:12]
  
  # timing = stimulus.started - block_instr.stopped
  time <- stimulus_started - block_instr_stopped
  
  # cue should now have only 12 values, one per block
  cue <- block_labels
  
  output_df <- data.frame(
    cue = cue,
    time = time,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  participant_id <- sub(
    pattern = "^(LARA[0-9]{3}).*",
    replacement = "\\1",
    x = tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file))
  )
  
  output_file <- file.path(output_folder, paste0(participant_id, "_timing.csv"))
  
  write.csv(output_df, output_file, row.names = FALSE)
}

```
